_help: Partner offers shown in the 'partners' bar on every page and on /partners.html. To add an offer copy one item, fill it in and set active to true. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (the offer shows from start until the end of the end day). topics (optional) = words from the page address, e.g. ["diploma", "syrian-documents"]; leave it out to show the offer on all pages; "home" = the Arabic and Dutch homepages. code is optional. Never publish an offer without the partner's written OK. whatsapp (optional) = number with country code, digits only, e.g. 31612345678. kind (optional) = what the partner does, shown after the name, e.g. {"ar": "مكتب ترجمة أوراق", "nl": "Vertaalbureau"}. strip_link (optional) = "whatsapp" makes the moving strip open a WhatsApp chat (needs whatsapp) instead of the website.
